task/environment/assets/seed_data.json (parsed fully: 10 users, 3 jobs, 16 applications, 127 messages, 3 notes, 6 reads) and solution/app/src/seed_data.json (byte-identical, sha256 a1c65c80...)
task/solution/app/public/index.html (sha256 dff857e8...), public/js/*.js, src/*.js grepped for probe strings
evidence: Every distinctive value the criteria/protocols tell the judge to create was checked against the seed (parsed in full) and the reference initial markup/client code; none is pre-satisfied. (1) Board probes: functional prompt.md:15 'Use your own new jobs and cards for every board protocol (suffix every title and name for this review)... never rely on starting counts'; J1/J2, A-F, V-Z, A2 are therefore new suffixed records; seed jobs are only Platform Engineer, Data Analyst, Product Designer and seed candidate names (Noor Haddad, Ivo Marek, Priya Nair, ... Mina Park) cannot match suffixed names. Notes, reject reasons, Activity lines and orders are all read on these new cards, so seeded notes ('Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.', 'References checked...', 'Portfolio is concept work only.') and Lena's seeded reject reason cannot satisfy them. (2) Gate probes (gates/constraints/judge.toml hro_gate_shared; functional/polish/visual prompt.md:11) demand 'a unique name and email (add a short suffix for this review)' and 'exactly one card'. (3) 'plain' (hro_msg_compose; prompt.md:47) is absent from seed and from index.html/public js (only 'text/plain' MIME string in board.js:242,303 drag code, not rendered text; 'plain' in seed occurs only inside 'explained' in generated_note). (4) Polish 'Call back on Fri' (hro_pol_live_board) is absent from seed/markup and is never saved; polish prompt.md:14 additionally says 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own', which neutralises carried-over drafts (scored suite runs functional before polish via rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1, test.sh run_suite). hro_pol_failed_send and hro_pol_session_resume require 'distinctive' replies. (5) Tomas link (hro_candidate_linked): the seed already gives tomas.varga@candidates.example an application (APP-201, Data Analyst), but the probe is a card on the review's new suffixed J2, and prompt.md:47 handles a pre-existing address ('if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3'); the seeded Data Analyst application cannot satisfy 'the card added ... becomes Tomas's application'. (6) Seeded values used as read-only baselines are correct in the seed and are not mutation probes: Platform Engineer Applied Greta(1), Ade(2), Marco(3), Screen Priya(1), Samuel(2) matches hro_restart/protocol Z; Noor note text matches exactly; Lena unread = 3 APP-301 messages - read_count 2 = 1 (hro_unread_counts); Noor's APP-101 has 120 messages, thread_page_size 30 (hro_thread_latest/earlier). hro_restart pairs these with many review-created revisions (jobs, orders, notes, messages, unread counts, activity) and 'starting data is not loaded again', per Colderwater lesson 15, so a reseed-on-boot app cannot pass on seed alone. (7) Workbook 'Deterministic Checks' check-probe-not-in-seed.py: sentinel values (e.g. JUDGE-SKU-9001) - this task names only 'plain' and 'Call back on Fri' as literal probes; both absent. Manual application, not a portal checker run. NOTE (latent, P3): message bodies used as the 'appeared' signal in timed observations are judge-chosen without a distinctness requirement: hro_msg_exchange (Tomas's reply; in the fallback path it runs on seeded APP-201 which already shows 'Thank you. I am glad to hear from you.'), hro_pol_live_thread (Noor's message in APP-101 whose latest 30 seeded messages include generic phrases such as 'Thursday afternoon works for me. (#120)'). The timed-observation rule only asks for 'fresh values' on void repeats (prompt.md:21). An LLM judge normally types a unique text, so no defect is demonstrated, but this is the one place a seeded string could pre-satisfy an 'appears' leg. Colderwater lessons bearing on this row checked: lesson 7/14 (fresh values on repeated timed attempts present), lesson 15 (restart re-reads many review-created revisions), lesson 16 (seeded baseline used read-only). No configured judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope says so); this row is source-decidable and no runtime measurement is required for it.
counterexample: Hypothetical weak app with no live push: in polish hro_pol_live_thread the judge has Noor send a generic text such as 'Thursday afternoon works for me'; the DOM poll finds the seeded message #120 already in view, records met=true, and the untouched draft/focus/scroll legs then pass trivially. Conforming-alternative check: none found that fails because a probe pre-exists (suffix rule, J3 fallback and 'clear existing draft' cover the collisions).
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: in functional prompt.md 'Timed observations' and polish prompt.md, require every message/note text the judge creates to carry the review suffix (e.g. '... [rv-xxxx]') so an 'appears' check can never be met by seeded text.
